content:
**Squirrels** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Squirrels have retained the general size and form of their pre-War counterparts. The main differences between pre-War and post-War squirrels are loss of fur, loss of cheek tissue, malformation of the eyes, and small growths along the body. Squirrels will flee from all hostile actors and have no attacks with which to defend themselves.

A standard squirrel found in the Appalachian wasteland.
